## About
ARC Auto Repair Center is a family owned and operated shop founded by Teddy and Wise Chen. A lot has changed since we started, but our focus on quality work at fair prices has stayed the same.
Teddy is our owner and master auto mechanic, and he looks over the work himself. We know your car, your money and your time matter, so we aim to get you back on the road safely at the lowest price we can.
Neighbors in Alief and drivers from across Houston have given us a 4.8 rating from 52 Google reviews. Call us or stop by the shop on Belle Park Dr.

## Services
- Brake service: Complete brake service, plus anti-lock brake diagnosis and repair.
- Engine repair: Complete engine repair, from diagnosis to getting it running right again.
- Electrical diagnosis and repair: Tracking down and fixing electrical and electronic system problems.
- Heating and air conditioning: Heating and air conditioning service to keep the cabin comfortable through a Houston summer.
- Computerized 4-wheel alignment: Computerized 4-wheel alignment, along with suspension and steering work.
- Oil service: Includes installing a new oil filter.

## FAQ
Q: How do I set up an appointment?
A: Give us a call or drop by the shop. We're located near Beechnut and Kirkwood.

Q: Are you open on Saturday?
A: Yes, Saturday from 8 AM to 12 PM.

Q: What forms of payment do you take?
A: We accept checks and cash, as well as MasterCard and Visa.
